z: 我看见一个长头发的女生。
e: I saw a girl with long hair.

z: 他把这记在他的笔记本上。
e: He wrote it down in his notebook.

z: 我会等在这儿直到他回来。
e: I'll wait here till he comes back.

z: 你的行为离要求的太远了。
e: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.

z: 她穿着一条很难看的裙子。
e: She was wearing an ugly dress.

z: 你钱或者信用卡带来没有？
e: Did you bring cash or your credit card with you?

z: 我已经好久没有去锻炼了。
e: I haven't exercised in a long time.

z: 除了我以外，大家都很忙。
请给我看一下你的笔记本。
有点儿晚了，我们该走了。
e: It's getting late, so we'd better get going.

z: 我在回家的路上遇到了他。
e: I met him on my way home.

z: 你不懂这句句子，不是吗？
e: You can't understand this sentence, can you?

z: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。
e: He only says these things as a joke.

z: 他写了很多关于中国的书。
e: He wrote a lot of books on China.

z: 我对我今天的表演不满意。
e: I am not satisfied with my performance today.

z: 他们要求我更努力地工作。
e: They require me to work harder.

z: 我穿好衣服，然后吃早饭。
e: I'm getting dressed, after which I will take my breakfast.

z: 这个学期我们有两次考试。
e: We have two examinations during this term.

z: 这个房子里有没有洗衣机？
e: Is there a washing machine in the house?

z: 我有钱，我胖而且我快乐。
e: I am rich, fat and happy.

z: 她告诉我关于她老师的事。
e: She told me the matter regarding her teacher.

z: 你收到了我发的邮件了吗？
昨天他遇到了高大的男人。
e: Yesterday he saw a big man.

z: 我可以听见你心里的声音。
e: I can hear the sound in your mind.

z: 她帮助了一位老人过马路。
e: She helped an old man across the street.

z: 我不喜欢五百页以上的书。
e: I don't like books with more than five hundred pages.

z: 再过两周你就可以出院了。
e: In another two weeks you will be able to get out of the hospital.

z: 我买了一本关于动物的书。
e: I bought a book about animals.

z: 我们每时每刻都准备好了。
e: At every moment we are ready for anything.

z: 日本的雨季什么时候开始？
e: When does the rainy season in Japan begin?

z: 他弟弟是个有名的足球选手。
e: His little brother is a famous soccer player.

z: 他和班上其他男生一样聪明。
e: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.

z: 我结婚了，而且有两个孩子。
e: I am married and have two children.

z: 我只想查一下我的电子邮件。
e: I just wanted to check my email.

z: 我们的老师会给我们出难题。
e: Our teacher will give us difficult problems.

z: 我跟那个事件没有什么关系。
e: I had nothing to do with that incident.

z: 我们非常难过的时候就会哭。
e: When we are very sad, we will cry.

z: 你声音大一点，我听不出来！
你今天下午想不想去动物园？
e: Would you like to go to the zoo this afternoon?

z: 它们对环境一点都没有影响。
e: They have no impact on the environment.

z: 我们在找一个漂亮的屋子住。
e: We are looking for a nice house to live in.

z: 他结婚了，而且有三个孩子。
e: He's married and has three children.

z: 他就是在这间屋子里出生的。
e: He was born in this very room.

z: 小孩儿不能在这条河里游泳。
e: Children can't swim in this river.

z: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？
他虽然年轻，但是位好医生。
e: Young as he is, he is a good doctor.

z: 我本来想走的，但后来忘了。
e: I wanted to go, but I forgot.

z: 走自己的路，让别人去说吧。
e: Follow your own path and let people talk.

z: 他是我们四人中间最年轻的。
e: He is the youngest amongst us four.

z: 这个酒吧的女服务员很漂亮。
e: This pub has very beautiful waitresses.

z: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。
e: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.

z: 上个星期我们在我阿姨的家。
e: We were at my aunt's last week.

z: 你知道商场什么时候关门吗？
e: Do you know when the supermarket closes?

z: 我在这个网站上能找到什么？
e: What can I find on this website?

z: 能为你服务我会感到非常高兴。
e: I'll be very happy if I can serve you.

z: 你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。
e: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.

z: 我希望不久以后你又能好起来。
e: I hope you will be quite well again before long.

z: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
e: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.

z: 一斤四元五毛，便宜得不得了！
e: 4.5 yuan for one pound, now isn't that cheap!

z: 我们的饭店在汽车南站的附近。
e: Our restaurant is near the southern bus station.

z: 我回来了！啊？我们有客人啊？
e: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?

z: 他是个画家，但他不会画国画。
e: He is a painter, but he can't paint in the traditional Chinese style.

z: 一般来说，男生跑得比女生快。
e: Generally speaking, boys can run faster than girls.

z: 他们在一边吃喝，一边聊天儿。
e: They are eating and drinking while chatting.

z: 你想把我们的两只羊一换一吗？
e: Do you want to trade our two sheep, one for another?

z: 我要一件新衬衫。你想要什么？
e: I want a new shirt. What do you want?

z: 下周我会给你写信或打电话的。
e: I'll write or phone you next week.

z: 我想要本书。书店在什么地方？
e: I want a book. Where is the bookstore?

z: 房子里面的人我一个也不认得。
e: I didn't recognize anyone in the room.

z: 我现在在上班，所以晚点打给你。
e: I'm at work now, so I'll call you later.

z: 我在想哪个跑步运动员会跑第一。
e: I wonder which of the runners will come first.

z: 我会告诉她开会的时候说些什么。
e: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.

z: 我跟你说过的那个女生住在这儿。
e: The girl about whom I told you lives here.

z: 可是这不是最后一班火车，对吧？
e: But that's not the last train, right?

z: 我只能走路，因为打不到出租车。
e: There are no taxis, so I must walk.

z: 你把衣服从洗衣机里拿出来了吗？
e: Did you take the clothes out of the washing machine?

z: 一年四季，我最喜欢夏天，你呢？
e: There are four seasons in a year, and the one I like most is summer. How about you?

z: 每个人到黑板前写下自己的名字。
e: Everyone came to the blackboard to write down their name.

z: 今天我休假，要不要一起玩游戏？
e: Since I have today off, shall we play a game?

z: 一般来说，男生会比女生高一些。
e: Boys, as a rule, are taller than girls.

z: 你知道为什么天看起来这么蓝吗？
e: Do you know the reason why the sky looks blue?

z: 这里的书店和图书馆没有外语书。
e: The book stores and libraries here have no books in foreign languages.

z: 学习一门语言最好的方法是什么？
e: What's the best way to learn a language?

z: 你一路往前走，过了红绿灯就到了。
e: Go straight down the road, and when you pass the traffic light you're there.

z: 经过银行，左边就是他的办公室了。
e: His office is past the bank on your left.

z: 我平时每天可能练习一个小时汉字。
e: Normally I might study Chinese characters for an hour a day.

z: 只有你好好学习才可以考得上大学。
e: Only if you study hard will you be able to get into university.

z: 你能告诉我你的姓名和手机号码吗？
e: Could you tell me your name and your number?

z: 他的儿子有才能，但是考不上大学。
e: His son has talent, but cannot pass the college entrance exam.

z: 别忘了在名单上写上你自己的名字。
e: Don't forget to fill in your name on the form.

z: 我们养了两只狗、三只猫和六只鸡。
e: We have two dogs, three cats, and six chickens.

z: 了解一家公司的文化为什么是重要的？
e: Why is it important to know about a company’s culture?

z: 我们九点上课，可是他九点一刻才来。
e: We start class at nine o'clock, but he didn’t come until quarter past.

z: 有人看到了她在饭馆跟她爱人在一起。
e: She was seen at a restaurant with her lover.

z: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。
e: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.

z: 他没有接电话，所以我给他发了封邮件。
e: He did not answer the phone, so I sent him an email.

z: 我们早上九点上课，可是他八点就来了。
e: We start class at 9am, but he came as early as 8 o’clock.

z: 今天的小饭馆明天就可以变成大饭店了。
e: The small restaurant of today may be a big hotel tomorrow.

z: 你的邮箱为什么发不过去邮件呢，奇怪。
e: Strange, why can't I send any mail to your mail box?

z: 要是我很有钱的话，我就会到处去旅游。
e: If I were rich, I would go travelling everywhere.

z: 为了提高我的汉语水平，我想去中国学习。
e: I'd like to study in China to improve the level of my Chinese.

z: “你看起来像游客。”“可我就是游客！”
e: "You look like a tourist." "But I am a tourist!"

z: 他们有眼睛，但看不见；有耳朵，但听不见。
e: They have eyes but they do not see - ears, and they do not hear.

z: 他以为我什么都不知道，其实我什么都知道。
e: He thinks I don't know anything about it, but, in reality, I know everything.

z: 工作日是：周一，周二，周三，周四，和周五。
e: The weekdays are: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.

z: 他心里对自己说“不！”。他大声说出“是。”。
e: He thought to himself, "No!" Aloud he said, "Yes."

z: 我常常想他会不会突然地出现在街角的咖啡店呢？
e: I often wonder if he'll suddenly appear at that coffee shop on the corner.
